test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

She now has more than a year as minister___________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"under her belt"** means having achieved or obtained something as part of one's experience or accomplishments. (अनुभव में होना)

 
 
• **Example:** He has several successful projects **under his belt.**
 
 
 
• **"under her belt"** refers to having successfully completed something or gained experience in a particular field. (अनुभव प्राप्त होना)
 
 
• **Example:** She now has more than a year as minister **under her belt.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **under her belt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **on thin ice** (खतरे में होना): In a precarious or risky situation.

 
 
• **Example:** You’re on thin ice with your boss after that mistake.
 
 
 
• **in the fast lane** (तेजी से आगे बढ़ना): Living a lifestyle marked by excitement, risk, and fast-paced activities.
 
 
• **Example:** He’s been living in the fast lane since he moved to the big city.
 
 
 
• **down for the count** (हराया हुआ): Defeated or unable to continue.
 
 
• **Example:** After that last setback, he’s down for the count.
